notes: Hand-authored from design-iv.md and candidate-1 coordinator decisions; exact names only, unmapped frames remain OTHER.

A primary sum is the constructor, cloneSlotSubtree recursion (including overlay Map copying in the same self frame, counted once) and getRetainedChildEntry search. A extended sum additionally includes createFieldNode and getSlotChildIndex. getSlotChildIndex also serves four slot-ordering/pruning callers, so the extended sum can exceed the A-removable share.
B decision sum omits unmapped helper self time and the three non-replaceable gate-evaluation functions; it is not an upper bound.
V8 attribution retains inlined JavaScript frame names in the independent probe; Map builtin work is charged to its calling JavaScript self frame in that probe.
Removed eight absent names: nodeFactory, finalizePendingExitLoop, finalizeRetainLoop, finalizeAncestorCollection, finalizeAncestorOutput, publishChildren, prepareChildSelection, removeNode

frameLocations.name: (anonymous)
frameLocations.evidence: finalizeExits passes this departing-node closure to visitFieldNodes; captures detached reads and marks the departing node detached

frameLocations.name: inLoadScope
frameLocations.evidence: finalizeExits local predicate prevents load-scope nodes from being retained or receiving automatic exit policies

nonReplaceableGateEvaluation.reason: These functions compute the next bucket that keys a descriptor; the descriptor cannot replace gate evaluation.

familyEvidence.createChildNode: Allocates and enters a child node; node lifetime A.
familyEvidence.enterSlotClone: Initializes a newly cloned public node on slot re-entry; node lifetime A.
familyEvidence.prepareGateTableRound: Prepares the literal table and bucket view for a switch round; switch machinery B.
familyEvidence.finishGateTableRound: Closes table-round bookkeeping; switch machinery B.
familyEvidence.canSkipGateWheel: Chooses the control-flow path for a switch round; switch machinery B.
familyEvidence.computeRootGateSelection: Selects root gate declarations; selectChildren family B.
familyEvidence.getGateSelectionTable: Reads/prepares the table used by child selection; switch machinery B.
familyEvidence.primeHost: Prepares a host for child selection; switch machinery B.
familyEvidence.registerPresenceChanges: Collects presence changes of selected children; switch machinery B.
familyEvidence.createPreparedSelectionStructure: Creates the ordered child structure published by publishPreparedSelection; switch machinery B.
familyEvidence.startFieldNodeChain: Opens the runtime write chain; fixed write cost C.
familyEvidence.flushQueuedEvents: Flushes queued event delivery after the write chain; fixed delivery cost C.
familyEvidence.publishStateKeys: Publishes settlement state keys for all writes; settlement fixed cost C.
familyEvidence.transitionSettlement: Runs transition rounds for entered nodes and gates; switch machinery B, not the fixed write floor.
familyEvidence.getSlotChildIndex: Slot child-order lookup used by getRetainedChildEntry and by slot ordering/pruning; node lifetime A, over-approximates the A-removable share.
